Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Higher Spend Came With Pricier Clicks For 14 B2B Google Advertisers
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Agency data covering 14 B2B advertisers shows that the same non-brand Google Ads keywords cost more per click even after controlling for the advertisers' own spending levels. The finding raises questions about auction dynamics that can affect organic vs. paid budget allocation decisions.
